light_setup: 420 nm LED array surrounding reactor coil

streams.pump_role: Liquid feed containing substrate, photocatalyst, and solvent
streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan stream_logic dictates single liquid stream. Flow rate derived from residence time calculation (0.3 min) and reactor volume (1.11 mL).
Chemistry Plan identifies O2 as reagent. Engineering calculation specifies 5.34 sccm air MFC to meet stoichiometric demand and mass transfer requirements.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan states all components can be mixed prior to irradiation. Gas-liquid mixing required for O2 transfer.
pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve Fmoc-L-methionine and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole in acetonitrile to 0.1 M.
Sparge liquid stream with air or mix with air MFC stream immediately before reactor inlet.
post_reactor_steps: Collect product solution. No quench required as per Chemistry Plan.
chemistry_notes: Photo-oxidation of sulfide to sulfoxide. Oxygen is a reactant; deoxygenation is prohibited. Reaction is mass-transfer limited (Da >> 1), requiring efficient gas-liquid mixing. Short residence time (0.3 min) enabled by high photon flux in flow. BPR required to maintain O2 solubility (Henry's Law) and prevent gas expansion.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2: 0.3 min based on 15x intensification factor from batch 5 min. Analogy 3 used 16 min but had poor mass transfer; our flow design improves mass transfer allowing shorter time.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system. Using inlet/STP basis as per universal physics rules for gas-liquid feeds. In-channel time is lower due to pressure compression of gas.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Batch condition 21 C. No thermal advantage needed. Analogy 2 used 50 C for different kinetics; we maintain batch temp.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: 3.0 bar required for gas-liquid system to maintain O2 solubility and prevent degassing. Analogy 3 used 10 bar; 3 bar is sufficient for MeCN bp and O2 solubility at 21 C.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP preferred for photocatalysis (transparent to 420 nm). Analogy 2 used FEP. Analogy 3 used PFA (also transparent). FEP selected for standard photo-flow compatibility.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Batch condition 0.1 M. Analogy 1 used 0.5 M, Analogy 2 used 0.05 M. Maintaining 0.1 M to match batch solubility and kinetics without optimization data.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculation Step 3: 1.11 mL derived from V = t * Q = 0.3 min * 0.5 mL/min. Analogy 3 used 4.6 mL for longer residence time.
reasoning_per_field.wavelength_nm: Chemistry Plan: 420 nm. Matches batch protocol. Analogy 1 used 455 nm, Analogy 2 used 440 nm, Analogy 3 used 700 nm. Must match catalyst absorption.
